about: The VISUAL TOUR with the Christmas layer forced on (?xmas=1): the views of tools/tour/views.json (docs/TOUR.md, docs/CHRISTMAS.md). The main tour runs with ?xmas=0 so its baseline does not flip on 1 December.

views.what: Place Saint-Job: shop fronts, the corner block (557601: its oriel front went hollow in the wall repair bug)
Saint-Job from 60 m: roofs, the church, the square, gardens
Rue du Ham: an ordinary terraced street (Saint-Job)
Rue Vanderkindere: 1920s-30s red-brick fronts, stone bands, oriels, shops
Avenue Brugmann: eclectic townhouses with oriels and balconies
Avenue Coghen: 1950s-60s red-brick blocks with long balconies, maisons de maitre
Avenue Winston Churchill: apartment blocks with balconies and bow windows
F3 balconied block 538418 from 25 m (loggia fronts: the hollow-front case)
Avenue du Prince d'Orange: villas behind hedges, gardens, entrance piers
Avenue De Fre: cottage villas behind hedges, garden walls and piers, 1960s blocks
Chaussee de Waterloo at Fort-Jaco: shops, the wide road
Chaussee de Waterloo over the railway at Vivier d'Oie (road-over-rail bridge 590)
Saint-Job station: the road deck over the platforms, the tram stop, railings
The Saint-Job rail bridge over the Chaussee de Saint-Job (hero bridge)
Parvis Saint-Pierre: setts, the church (landmark)
Cortenbosch: herringbone pavers, 1990s houses, painted words
Lycee Francais Jean Monnet: the school front (glass curtain wall, railings)

tol.why: a surface behind the gate railing is lit in one run, dark in the next (17-20 % of one cell, source not found)

views.what: The police station (Rue Rouge) and its street
Parc de Wolvendael from 70 m: trees, lawns, paths
From 300 m up: the far city (far ring tiles, impostors, landmarks far away)
Rue Vanderkindere at night: shop windows, street lamps, night lights
Chaussee d'Alsemberg with traffic and parked cars (moving cars: looser thresholds)
Christmas (claude/xmas2): Place Saint-Job at night from the east, eye height, 24 m from the fir: the 10 m fir (LEDs, baubles, star), the 6-chalet market, the square's garland; bloom on the LEDs
Christmas (claude/xmas2): Place Saint-Job at dusk from the west (the stjob-street spot): the fir and the market against the twilight sky, the LEDs at their day-to-night level

Christmas (claude/xmas2): Parvis Saint-Pierre at night: the 9 m fir before the church (the parvis lost its 4 garlands that hooked on the hidden UrbIS church solid, claude/xmas1: none may come back on the church)
Christmas (claude/xmas2): Rue Xavier De Bue at dusk looking east: garlands across the street (stars mid-span, the tram span at -898 without one), shopfront swags, lamp snowflakes

Christmas (claude/xmas2): a shopfront swag and a door wreath at night, Rue Xavier De Bue (Maroquinerie Karwan + the wreath of no. 36A, Les Petits Riens next door): swag along the drawn front, the wreath on the door at 1.7 m
